word-noun.def: a word that names a person, place, thing or idea

word-verb.def: a word that tells what someone or something does or is

word-adjective.def: a word that tells more about a person or thing, such as its size or color

word-adverb.def: a word that tells how, when or where something is done

word-pronoun.def: a short word like he or it that is used instead of a name

word-preposition.def: a word like in or on that shows place, time or direction

word-conjunction.def: a word like and or but that joins words or sentences

word-article-grammar.def: a small word like a or the that comes before a noun

word-syllable.def: a part of a word that has one vowel sound

word-vowel.def: a speech sound made with the mouth open, like a or o

word-consonant.def: a speech sound made by blocking or narrowing the air, like b or t

word-alphabet.def: the set of letters used to write a language

word-spelling.def: the correct order of letters in a word

word-pronunciation.def: the way a word is said aloud

word-tone-grammar.def: the rise or fall of the voice on a syllable that can change a word's meaning

word-synonym.def: a word that means the same or almost the same as another word

word-antonym.def: a word that means the opposite of another word

word-singular.def: the form of a word that means only one

word-plural.def: the form of a word that means more than one

word-grammatical-gender.def: the group of masculine, feminine or neuter words in some languages

word-masculine.def: describing words in the male group in languages that sort words this way

word-feminine.def: describing words in the female group in languages that sort words this way

word-neuter.def: describing words that are neither male nor female in grammar

word-tense.def: the form of a verb that shows when something happens

word-past-tense.def: the verb form that shows something already happened

word-present-tense.def: the verb form that shows something happening now or regularly

word-future-tense.def: the verb form that shows something will happen later

word-grammatical-case.def: the form of a noun that shows its role in a sentence, such as subject or object

word-conjugation.def: the set of forms a verb takes for person, number and time

word-declension.def: the set of forms a noun or adjective takes for role, number and gender

word-infinitive.def: the basic form of a verb, often used with to, like to go

word-punctuation.def: the marks used in writing to separate sentences and show meaning

word-comma.def: the small mark that shows a short pause in a sentence

word-full-stop.def: the dot at the end of a sentence

word-question-mark.def: the sign written at the end of a sentence that asks something

word-capital-letter.def: a large letter like A or B, used at the start of names and sentences

word-abbreviation.def: a shorter way of writing a word or phrase

word-vocabulary.def: all the words that a person knows or uses

word-idiom.def: a phrase whose meaning is different from the meanings of its separate words

word-slang-word.def: very informal words used mostly in casual talk among friends

word-dialect.def: a form of a language spoken in one region or by one group

word-native-speaker.def: someone who has used a language since early childhood

word-mother-tongue.def: the first language a person learns as a child

word-foreign-language.def: a way of speaking that belongs to another country and is not your own

word-fluent.def: able to speak or write a language easily and well

word-translator.def: a person whose job is to change text or speech from one language to another

word-exercise-task.def: a short task in a book that helps you practice something

word-textbook.def: a printed guide used by students to study a school subject

word-flashcard.def: a small piece of paper with a question on one side and the answer on the other

word-beginner.def: a person who has just started learning something

word-advanced.def: at a high level of skill or knowledge

word-intermediate.def: at a level after the first stage but before the highest

word-reading.def: the activity of looking at written words and understanding them

word-writing.def: the activity of putting words on paper or a screen

word-listening.def: the activity of paying attention to sounds or speech

word-spell.def: to say or write the letters of a word in the right order

word-memorize.def: to learn something so well that you can repeat it without looking

word-stress-accent.def: extra force put on one part of a word when you say it

word-expression.def: a word or group of words used together to say something
